content: Tombstone GC via causal stability in ORDHMap-style operation-al CRDTs: Yorkie (open-source CRDT document DB) physically purges tombstones only when a minimum version vector across ALL active clients covers the tombstone's lamport timestamp (server computes element-wise min VV during PushPull; clients GC after applying remote changes; GC disable flag; purge-count metrics). General literature (From Causality to Stability, MPLR 2020; causal-stability write-ups) confirms causal stability is the natural GC trigger but requires known membership and reliable causal broadcast; a permanently-offline replica freezes the causal frontier unless membership is bounded/pruned. ralph/ORDHMap repo itself was not directly reachable (404/search); mechanism inferred from cross-checked secondary sources.
